Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, is seated in a wheelchair. He is surrounded by his family and friends, all beaming with pride.

GEORGE
(through gritted teeth)
I Don't Understand Why I'm Still Here

The officials present George with a certificate and a gold medal, proclaiming him the oldest human to ever live.

REPORTER 1
 Congratulations, Mr. George! You've achieved a remarkable feat. How does it feel?

GEORGE
(looking around the room)
It Feels Like A Dream. A Never-Ending Nightmare.

The room erupts in applause as George's family and friends congratulate him. As the celebration dies down, George makes his way back to his home, a small apartment on the outskirts of town.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

George lies in bed, surrounded by old photographs and mementos. He looks tired and worn out. Suddenly, he sits up in bed and begins to rummage through his old books and papers.

GEORGE
(to himself)
Quantum Immortality... I Remember Reading About It Online...

As he flips through the pages, his eyes widen with a mix of excitement and terror.

GEORGE
(whispering)
It Can't Be True... But What If It Is?

George's mind begins to wander, and he starts to imagine the impossible. He sees himself living forever, witnessing the birth and death of stars, and experiencing the entirety of human history.

GEORGE
(losing his grip on reality)
I'm Not Just Old... I'm Immortal. I'm The Only One Who's Ever Lived.

As the night wears on, George's mental state deteriorates. He becomes convinced that he is the only one who truly understands the nature of reality.

GEORGE
(rocking back and forth in bed)
I'm The Only One Who Knows The Truth. I'm The Only One Who's Ever Lived.

The camera zooms in on George's face, his eyes wild and unfocused. His breathing becomes labored, and his body begins to shake.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I'm Not Alone... I'm The Only One Who's Ever Lived.

The camera lingers on George's face as he descends into madness, the sound of his own whispers echoing through the room.

FADE TO BLACK.
